text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working freelancer with 6 years of experience in Python, machine learning, and NLP, and I’d love to help you produce AI lookbook videos with the style and quality you’re after.

I understand you need 1-minute-40-second videos built from AI-generated images, with special effects and transitions between photos, delivered in HD quality. I can follow a consistent visual structure so each video feels polished, engaging, and aligned with the reference style you shared. I also understand the importance of keeping the workflow efficient when producing videos in volume, especially when thumbnails are part of the package.

While my background is primarily in Python-based machine learning and NLP work, I’ve built practical production tools around model-driven content workflows. For example, in my Coffee review themes project for Cobalt Coffee Roasters, I built a small Streamlit app using Python, BERTopic, Hugging Face Transformers, and pandas that grouped 38k marketplace reviews into themes and tracked sentiment per theme each week. That project produced 12 stable themes and replaced about 2 days a month of manual tagging. That experience strengthened my ability to organize large batches of content, keep output consistent, and build efficient systems around repetitive creative tasks.

I also bring experience with PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning, which helps me work comfortably with AI-generated assets and structured content pipelines. If needed, I can help keep the process organized so the videos maintain a consistent look, pacing, and visual flow across many pieces.

I’m reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working at scale. If you’d like, I’d be glad to discuss your preferred video style, transition approach, and thumbnail requirements so I can make sure the final output matches your expectations.
